text:
nina (Partnerships): Heads-up: QuantumFlux sent final assets for the joint solution brief and marketplace tile. Need quick pass on badge legibility, certification icons, and the 'tested on' heater spec callout. Drive-by Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/qf/QuantumFlux-Redwood-joint
omar (Design): opening. Badge looks great but their hex background collides with our card shadow at 1:1. Recommend flattening to transparent PNG and adding a 8px white halo for marketplace thumbnails.
prateek (PMM): Marketplace requires a small certification row (e.g., "FIPS-140-2 Verified") — do we have permissions to display QuantumFlux's cert marks?
lucy (Legal): We need written permission for using third-party certification logos and any certification claims. Also, callout 'sustained 95C thermal' may trigger product safety review; please confirm test lab and report.
hannah (Localization): For the brief, short-form headlines need to be <50 chars for JP/KR. I'll create alternates. Also recommend we avoid temperature units in the headline — local conventions differ.
omar (Design): Added two hero variants: one with transparent badge + white halo, one with badge-overlaid box. Exported thumbnails at 80px and 120px per marketplace specs.
prateek (PMM): For the 'tested on QuantumFlux QX-200' line — let's use 'validated on QF QX-200 in Redwood internal tests' unless lab report available. Keeps it safe.
asset-bot: Assets uploaded but checklist incomplete: missing certification permission, lab report attachment, and localized headlines. Deadline: 5 business days.
nina (Partnerships): Action items: 1) @lucy request cert logo permission and lab report from QuantumFlux, 2) @omar finalize halo thumbs and provide badge-only glyph, 3) @hannah supply localized headlines (JP, KR, DE), 4) @prateek adjust product callout language to include 'internal tests' unless lab is provided. I'll ping their PM.
omar (Design): Quick note: badge-only glyph looks blurry at 44px. Recommend simplified monoline glyph. I'll iterate.
lucy (Legal): I'll draft a short permission template to request cert logo and any claims substantiation. Will copy Nina on outreach.
prateek (PMM): Also let's avoid absolute claims in tile metadata. Use 'reduced inference latency in internal benchmarks' instead of numeric percent until we have third-party validation.
hannah (Localization): Posting drafts in thread: JP headline: '\u30af\u30a4\u30c3\u30af\u3057\u3066QX-200\u3067\u30c6\u30b9\u30c8\u3057\u307e\u3057\u305f', KR headline: '\ud2b8\ub77c\ub9ac\ubc0d QX-200 \uc5d0\uc11c \ud14c\uc2a4\ud2b8\ub97c \ub9cc\ub4e4\uc5b4\ub294\ub2e4'. Let me know on length.
asset-bot: Reminder: include alt-text short and long variants for each image before handoff.
nina (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll compile the checklist and schedule a 15-min sign-off call with QuantumFlux PM for tomorrow.
